topic: Menstrual cycle phases: hormonal shifts and energy levels
caption: Did you know your menstrual cycle affects your energy levels? 🌟 Learn how to sync your activities with your cycle for better productivity. Here are the 4 phases: Menstruation (days 1-5), Follicular (days 6-14), Ovulation (day 14), and Luteal (days 15-28). 💡 Save this so you don't lose it. Share with someone who needs to see this.
